release.description: Research-only public suite of 64 original and synthetic medical-physics tasks spanning core physics, imaging, radiation therapy, brachytherapy, nuclear medicine, radiation safety, quality assurance, informatics, and research statistics. Tasks are calculation, bounded interpretation, or safe-escalation exercises and do not authorize clinical action.
